<!-- Generated by esquadro docs from the blueprint's manifest: do not edit. -->

A TypeScript client of the API, generated from the model into clients/ts: typed records (fields and include narrow them), the lists' filters, safe writes (If-Match, Idempotency-Key), the model's rules to check forms, errors with their code and, with security, the identity routes. It needs nothing but fetch: browsers, Node, Bun and edge runtimes. With github_actions, each tag v* publishes it as an npm package, versioned as the tag, to GitHub Packages or npmjs.

```esquadro
blueprint client_ts
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [rest](../rest/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [security](../security/), [github_actions](../github_actions/) when the app uses them.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `package` | string | `""` | The package's name; @&lt;owner>/&lt;app>-client by default, the owner from the module (github.com/&lt;owner>/...) or the scope option. |
| `scope` | string | `""` | The npm scope, without @, when the module is not on GitHub. |
| `registry` | name | `"github"` | Where tags publish it: github (GitHub Packages, with the workflow's own token) or npmjs (trusted publishing, without a token). |

```esquadro
blueprint client_ts {
  package ""
}
```
